hook.en: Two students both average 70% in tests. One always scores 68–72; the other swings between 40 and 100. Same mean, very different stories! Measures of dispersion tell you how spread out — how consistent — data is.
hook.bm: Dua pelajar sama-sama mendapat purata 70% dalam ujian. Seorang sentiasa mendapat 68–72; seorang lagi berubah antara 40 dan 100. Min yang sama, cerita yang sangat berbeza! Sukatan serakan memberitahu betapa tersebarnya — betapa konsistennya — data.

bigIdeas.en: Dispersion measures how spread out data is around its centre.
bigIdeas.bm: Serakan mengukur betapa tersebarnya data di sekitar pusatnya.

bigIdeas.en: Range = largest − smallest; IQR = Q3 − Q1 (middle 50%).
bigIdeas.bm: Julat = terbesar − terkecil; julat antara kuartil = Q3 − Q1 (50% di tengah).

bigIdeas.en: Variance and standard deviation use every value; SD is in the same unit as the data.
bigIdeas.bm: Varians dan sisihan piawai menggunakan setiap nilai; sisihan piawai dalam unit yang sama dengan data.

bigIdeas.en: Smaller dispersion = more consistent data. Outliers strongly affect range and SD.
bigIdeas.bm: Serakan lebih kecil = data lebih konsisten. Pencilan sangat mempengaruhi julat dan sisihan piawai.

definition.en: How spread out a set of data is.
Q1, Q2 (median), Q3 split ordered data into four equal parts.
definition.bm: Q1, Q2 (median), Q3 membahagikan data tersusun kepada empat bahagian sama.

definition.en: Mean of the squared distances from the mean.
definition.bm: Min bagi kuasa dua jarak dari min.

definition.en: A value far away from the rest of the data.
definition.bm: Nilai yang jauh daripada data lain.

question.en: Find the mean, variance and standard deviation of 2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9.
question.bm: Cari min, varians dan sisihan piawai bagi 2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9.

prompt.en: Set P: 68, 70, 72. Set Q: 40, 70, 100. Which statement is true?
prompt.bm: Set P: 68, 70, 72. Set Q: 40, 70, 100. Pernyataan manakah benar?

options.en: Both have the same mean, but Q is more dispersed
options.bm: Kedua-duanya mempunyai min yang sama, tetapi Q lebih terserak

explanation.en: Both means are 70; Q's range (60) is much larger than P's (4).
explanation.bm: Kedua-dua min ialah 70; julat Q (60) jauh lebih besar daripada P (4).

prompt.en: A smaller measure of dispersion means the data is…
prompt.bm: Sukatan serakan yang lebih kecil bermakna data…

explanation.en: Values cluster closely around the centre.
explanation.bm: Nilai-nilai berkumpul rapat di sekitar pusat.

explanation.en: 7 values: Q1 = 2nd value = 3, Q3 = 6th value = 11. IQR = 11 − 3 = 8.
explanation.bm: 7 nilai: Q1 = nilai ke-2 = 3, Q3 = nilai ke-6 = 11. JAK = 11 − 3 = 8.

prompt.en: A data set has variance 9. What is its standard deviation?
prompt.bm: Satu set data mempunyai varians 9. Berapakah sisihan piawainya?

prompt.en: Data: 3, 5, 7. Find the standard deviation (2 d.p.).
Every value in a data set is increased by 5. What happens to the standard deviation?
prompt.bm: Setiap nilai dalam satu set data ditambah 5. Apakah yang berlaku kepada sisihan piawai?

explanation.en: The mean shifts by 5 but the spread doesn't change. (Multiplying every value by k multiplies SD by k.)
explanation.bm: Min beralih sebanyak 5 tetapi serakan tidak berubah. (Mendarab setiap nilai dengan k mendarab sisihan piawai dengan k.)

prompt.en: Which measure of dispersion is LEAST affected by an outlier?
prompt.bm: Sukatan serakan manakah PALING KURANG dipengaruhi pencilan?

explanation.en: IQR ignores the top and bottom 25%, where outliers sit.
explanation.bm: JAK mengabaikan 25% teratas dan terbawah, tempat pencilan berada.

prompt.en: Order the steps to find the standard deviation.

explanation.en: Use the calculator's STAT mode to check your answer.
explanation.bm: Gunakan mod STAT kalkulator untuk menyemak jawapan.
